# commons-value

> Sealed Intermediate Representation (IR) value types for the Cobra static analysis engine.

commons-value defines language-agnostic IR types (package root `edu.jhu.cobra.commons.value`, serializers in `edu.jhu.cobra.commons.value.serializer`) used to store and transport values across Cobra analysis modules. IR types attach to graph properties and flow through data-flow analyses. They carry no language-specific semantics -- language adapters in each analysis module handle the mapping from source language constructs to IR values.

## Instructions for Agents

- Use IR types (`StrVal`, `IntVal`, `FloatVal`, `BoolVal`, `NullVal`, `Unsure`, `ListVal`, `SetVal`, `MapVal`, `RangeVal`) for all graph property values.
- Convert Kotlin natives to IR via extension properties: `42.intVal`, `3.14.floatVal`, `"hello".strVal`, `true.boolVal`, `null.toVal`.
- Convert collections via extension properties: `list.listVal`, `set.setVal`, `map.mapVal`, `(1..10).rangeVal`.
- Use `Any?.toVal` for generic conversion when the source type is unknown at compile time.
- Dispatch on IR type with exhaustive `when` -- `IValue` is sealed, so the compiler enforces completeness.
- Use `Unsure` variants (`Unsure.STR`, `Unsure.NUM`, `Unsure.BOOL`, `Unsure.ANY`) to represent unknown-but-typed values in abstract interpretation.
- Serialize IR values with `DftByteArraySerializerImpl`, `DftByteBufferSerializerImpl`, or `DftCharBufferSerializerImpl`.
- Never add language-specific semantics (PHP, Java, Python) to this library. Language mapping belongs in analysis modules.
- Never subclass IR types. The sealed hierarchy is fixed.

## Core IR Types

- [IR Value Types](llms/core.md): Sealed type hierarchy -- `IValue`, `IPrimitiveVal`, `ICollectionVal`, and all concrete types.

## Serialization

- [Serializers](llms/serializers.md): Three `IValSerializer` implementations for `ByteArray`, `ByteBuffer`, and `CharBuffer`.

## Conversion Extensions

- [Conversions](llms/conversions.md): Kotlin extension properties and functions for native-to-IR conversion and regex.

## Optional

- [Full Reference](llms/full.txt): All L1 docs concatenated for single-load context.
